host: Firefly Blue Ghost Mission 3 / CLPS CP-21
lab_use: Do not wait for a Lunar-VISE night, night-TVAC, or night CONOPS. UCF printed a 10-day science investigation. Honeybee printed one lunar day. CP-21 is 2028. PI Kerri Donaldson-Hanna (UCF).

quotes.text: The 10-day science investigation will use the rover and lander operations to collect surface spectral and imaging measurements at high spatial resolutions on the dome summit.
The rover will complete an up to 1.1 km traverse over one lunar day and operate at a radius of up to 500 m from Firefly’s lander.
Firefly Aerospace is flying six investigations to Gruithuisen Gamma Dome (36°N, 40°W) in 2028 for NASA’s Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) CP-21 mission.
PI: Kerri Donaldson-Hanna, University of Central Florida
